translation.name: Lipatanu Lya Syayi Kwa Wantu Woseri

content: Shisoweru sha Mlungu kupitira Mwana gwakuwi
Makashu Mlungu katakuliti na wambuyi wetu mala zivuwa kwa ntambu zivuwa kwa njira ya wambuyi wakuwi,
kumbiti mashaka aga ga upeleru, kankutakula na twenga kwa njira ya Mwana gwakuwi ndomweni yakamusyagula kaweri mhala gwa vintu vyoseri, na kwa njira yakuwi Mlungu kanyawiti pasipanu.

Yomberi ndo mng'ereng'eta gwa ukwisa wa Mlungu, na kalifana nakamu ntambu ya Mlungu mweni, yakavitanga vintu vyoseri kwa shisoweru shakuwi shana makakala. Pakawapunga kala wantu vidoda vyawu, kalikala kumpindi uwega wa kumliwu wa Mlungu mkulu.
Mwana gwa Mlungu ndo mkulu kuliku wantumintumi wa kumpindi
Mwana katenditwi mkulu kuliku wantumintumi wa kumpindi, kapananitwi litawu likulu nentu kuliku womberi.
Mana Mlungu kamgambiriti ndiri nakamu ata yumu gwa ntumintumi gwa kumpindi,

content.text: “Gwenga gwa Mwana gwangu,
neni leru nwera Tati gwaku.”
Hakeni takuli visoweru avi kwa ntumintumi gwa kumpindi yoseri
“Neni hanweri Tati gwakuwi,
Na yomberi hakaweri Mwana gwangu.”

content: Kumbiti pakamujega pasipanu Mwana gwakuwi, mwiwuku gwa kwanja, Mlungu kalonga,

content.text: “Wantumintumi wa kumpindi woseri wa Mlungu wamguwiri.”

content: Kumbiti kwa wantumintumi wa kumpindi, kalonga,

content.text: “Mlungu kawatenda wantumintumi wa kumpindi waweri gambira liyega,
Na wantumintumi wakuwi kawatenda kuwera gambira mpamba zya motu.”
“Ufalumi waku gwee Mlungu, ulikali mashaka goseri!
Na luhonga lwa ukolamlima lwalumfiriziya Mlungu haluweri luhonga lwa Ufalumi waku.”

content: “Gwenga gufira kumfiriziya Mlungu na gulema makondola.

content.text: Ndo toziya Mlungu, Mlungu gwaku, kakusyagula gwenga,
Na kukuswaga lipaki, lipaki lya nemeru nkulu kuliku wayagu.”
“Mtuwa gwenga, gutuliti liyanjiru lya pasipanu pakwanja,
Mpindi vulaa ndo lihengu lya mawoku gaku.
Azi haziperi kumbiti gwenga hagusigali mashaka goseri,
Zoseri hazisakali gambira nguwu.
Haguzipindipindi gambira likoti,
Na zyeni hazisakali gambira nguwu ntambu yazisakala,
Kumbiti gwenga ndo ulaa uliya mashaka goseri,
Na mivinja yaku yahera upeleru.”

content: Mlungu kamgambiriti ndiri nakamu ata yumu gwa ntumintumi gwakuwi gwa kumpindi,

content.text: “Gulikali uwega wangu wa kumliwu
Mpaka nuwatuli wang'ondu waku
pasi pamagulu gaku.”

content: Wantumintumi wa kumpindi ndo washina gaa? Ndo rohu yazimtendera Mlungu na yazilagaliritwi kuwatanga walii hawanki ulopoziya.
